package.name: rosbag2_dynamic_recorder_interfaces
package.description:
Service definitions for runtime topic management on a rosbag2 recorder: subscribe, unsubscribe and atomically replace the recorded topic set.
Field naming and the return_code convention deliberately follow the style of the existing rosbag2_interfaces services, so these read as a natural extension of them. Reading the current set uses rosbag2_interfaces/srv/GetSubscribedTopics rather than redefining it.
